about_the_game:
An abandoned school at midnight...

Players split into two roles: "Hiders" and "Oni (Seeker)," battling it out in fast-paced 3-minute rounds. Your only lifeline is the flashlight in your hand. Read the play of light and shadow, sound and presence—hold your breath, run, and escape.

But this isn't your ordinary game of KAKUREONI -a deadly game of hide-and-seek-.

Something inhuman lurks in the darkness—

a third presence that will never side with the living.

This is the story of children, spirited away into the night, struggling to find their way back home to their families.

◆3-Minute High-Speed Rounds – Tense, replayable matches you can experience again and again.

◆Asymmetrical Multiplayer Horror – Two sides with different roles: Hiders and Oni (Seeker), each with unique thrills.

◆Light and Sound Mind Games – Flashlight beams, flickers, reflections, footsteps, even breathing can give you away.

◆Walkie-Talkie Communication – Exclusive to Hiders, but beware… ghosts may be listening nearby.

◆A Third Threat – An otherworldly being roams the map, mixing patterns and randomness to disrupt the game.

◆Fragments of the Story – Clues gathered between rounds piece together the night of the disappearance.

◆Thrill in Spectator Mode – Even after being caught, you can spectate and share the tension with others.

name: かくれ鬼
short_description: This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Deep within pitch-black ruins, with only the beam of a flashlight to guide you, the children must play KAKUREONI -a deadly game of hide-and-seek- to bring an end to the ritual of reincarnation.
